notes.title: 🚨 Scam Warning – No Public Beta Yet
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been made aware of a [b]scam going around[/b] where someone is pretending to be part of the [i]Many Ducks[/i] team and offering a fake beta download through unofficial websites.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]❗ If you’ve seen a link to a "Many Ducks beta" from a site like many-ducks<DOT>com, [b]it’s not from us.[/b]
These are [b]not legitimate[/b], and downloading from them could put your device at risk.[/p][/quote][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛡️ Stay Safe – Here's How to Tell It's Really Us:[/h3][list][*][p]✅ We are [b]not currently running any public playtests[/b] [b]or beta sign-ups[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ All official testing and game access will happen [b]right here on Steam[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Any big announcements will come from this page or our official social channels listed at the bottom.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚫 What You Should NOT Do:[/h3][list][*][p]Don’t download [i]Many Ducks[/i] from any website other than our [b]official Steam page[/b] here. Any other link is not authorized and could be dangerous.[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t give out your information to anyone claiming to offer early access[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you see someone sharing suspicious links, [b]please report them[/b], and feel free to let us know too. We’re taking steps to shut this down and protect the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for looking out for each other and for your excitement about [i]Many Ducks[/i]! 🦆💛[/p][p][/p][p]Stay cozy and stay safe,
[b]– The Duck Forge team[/b][/p]
